card.name: Linking words before brand-name drugs
card.fires_on: Small linking words such as 'with', 'or', 'of' and punctuation just before a brand-name cancer drug is named, in oncology treatment text.

modes.label: with before drug
modes.description: The word 'with' right after 'treated' or 'in combination' and before a brand drug name.
modes.example: docetaxel following FEC, and 11% of patients treated<< with>> PERJETA in combination with TCH

modes.label: or between regimen parts
modes.description: The word 'or' joining therapies or drugs in a combination regimen.
modes.example: Penpulimab-kcqx in Combination with Either Cisplatin<< or>> Carboplatin and Gemcitabine

modes.label: comma, colon or of before drug
modes.description: Punctuation or 'of' right before a brand name that starts a dosing instruction.
modes.example: 3) For the induction treatment of locally advanced inoperable SCCHN<<,>> the recommended dose of BEIZRAY is
